# 04 - Multi-Page Templates, Backgrounds & Discovery

## 1. Template Backgrounds
- Configured at the page/template level.
- **SVG Preferred**: Scalable vector patterns (floral garlands, traditional mandalas, geometric borders, textured grain) ensure crisp rendering on all screen sizes.
- Creators can customize background color washes, gradient overlays, and decorative opacity.

---

## 2. Multi-Page Template Architecture
Templates can span single or multiple distinct pages:

```text
Multi-Page Template
├── Page 1: Welcome & Cover
├── Page 2: Main Event Schedule
├── Page 3: Photo Gallery
├── Page 4: Interactive Venue & Map
└── Page 5: RSVP & Greetings
```

### Supported Page Operations:
- **Add Page**: Insert new blank canvas or duplicate existing page.
- **Delete Page**: Remove unwanted pages.
- **Reorder Pages**: Drag-and-drop page sequence.
- **Independent Canvases**: Modifying elements on Page 1 does not alter Page 2.

---

## 3. Export & Download Relationship
- **Single-page Templates**: Renderable as High-res Image (PNG) + Vector PDF.
- **Multi-page Templates**: Exportable as a consolidated multi-page Vector PDF document.

---

## 4. Search, Discovery & Live Preview
- **Search Filters**: Event Type, Color Theme, Aesthetic Style (Traditional, Minimalist, Luxury, Floral, Modern), Tier (Basic / Premium).
- **Interactive Previews**: Dynamic live preview renders responsive mobile and desktop viewports before the user commits to template selection.
- **Attribution**: Community templates clearly display creator profile attribution.
